items.text: `src/infrastructure/comp/storage/disk-file-storage.adapter.ts` — implements `FileStoragePort`; `put(key, buffer, contentType)`: writes `Buffer` to `path.join(COMP_STORAGE_DIR, key)`; returns `{ url: '/covers/' + key }`; `delete(url)`: derives file path from url; `fs.rm` with `{ force: true }` (no error on ENOENT)
`src/infrastructure/comp/storage/disk-file-storage.adapter.spec.ts` — put writes file and returns url; delete removes file; delete on missing file → no error thrown

`store('cover-123.jpg', buffer)` creates file at COMP_STORAGE_DIR/cover-123.jpg and returns a `file://` URL string — API real diverge do texto original (metodo `store` em vez de `put`, retorno `Promise<string>` em vez de `{url}`, URL `file://` em vez de `/covers/key`); ver `src/modules/comp/ports/file-storage.port.ts` — comportamento testado em `disk-file-storage.adapter.spec.ts`
